correctness.rationale: For the explicit L(Q3) graph, the full reduced weight-three degree-three chain group has 5940 generators and its boundary has 5916 integer unit pivots, yielding exactly 24 primitive kernel coordinates and no degree-four boundaries. The standalone verifier exhaustively generates 1422 cycles, 60 disjoint triples, verifies all torus boundaries, computes a determinant -1 for 24 selected torus vectors, exact rational short rank 20, and a determinant-one 20-by-20 short torus minor. Therefore the 44 short-cycle tori generate a primitive rank-20 lattice and the exact quotient is Z^4. This is a finite complete integer proof, not sampling; limitations concern only other particle numbers/graphs and independent validation.

value.rationale: The cuboctahedral graph is canonical and vertex-transitive, and geometric product-torus generators are natural configurations of disjoint moving particles. The unexpected, precisely motivated invariant is the smallest maximum simple-cycle length that integrally generates top homology: triangles/squares already contribute 20 of 24 primitive classes, all pentagon products are redundant, and hexagons fill four missing directions. The exact Z^4 obstruction is not entailed by the Betti number or a general chain model, and can guide topological generating-set questions in other graphs without claiming a universal theorem.
